ResearchProjectDef.label: Servitude Imperpituis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Convert unfortunate beings into servitors - lobotomised cyborgs designed for specific tasks and roles and with no will or mind of their own.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Any person can be turned into a mindless cyborg servant by installing a servitor chip in their brain. Different types of chip exist for different purposes, such as lexomats for intellectual tasks, or medicae servitors for medical care. Servitors have no mind of their own and require significantly less nutrition than a standard human, but cannot learn or improve in the way a fully conscious person can.

Prisoners who undergo servitorization will be automatically recruited and converted to the dominant ideoligion of the colony (if applicable).

The process is irreversible.
